pages.text: The Philosopher's Stone has picked up some local color.

pages.title: How to Paint
pages.text: Point the Stone at honest terrain and right-click: the block turns Crystal on the spot, exactly like any other world transmutation. Raise the Stone's charge to widen the brush from a single block to a broad sweep, and sneak-click to pick a block's alternate shade where one exists.$(p)It paints matter, not value — see the small print at the end.

pages.title: The Palette
pages.text: $(li)Stone and cobblestone: crystal stone$(li)Dirt and grass: crystal grass$(li)Oak logs and planks: crystal timber$(li)Oak leaves and saplings: crystal, two shades each$(li)Dandelions and poppies: crystal flowers — yellow or green, red or blue$(p)A whole build in $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/crystal_dimension)Crystal Dimension$() dress, and no termite ever checked your pockets.

pages.title: The Undo Button
pages.text: The three terrain blocks transmute back — crystal stone to stone, crystal grass to dirt, crystal log to oak — so a misclick is a redo, not a renovation.$(p)Small print: none of the crystal blocks carry EMC in this addon's tables, and this feature adds none. Terraforming, never a condenser feed — the $(l:orespawn_integrations:always_uranium/uranium_economy)EMC ledger$() stays audited and boring.
